Reverse each k-segment using the head/tail swap trick. O(n).

For reverse k group basic I will walk in steps of k, reversing each segment.

```python
def reverse_k_group(head, k):
    cur = head
    for _ in range(k):
        if not cur: return head
        cur = cur.next
    cur = head
    prev = None
    for _ in range(k):
        nxt = cur.next
        cur.next = prev
        prev = cur
        cur = nxt
    head.next = reverse_k_group(cur, k)
    return prev
```
